name: whisperr
description: Install the Whisperr SDK with your own coding agent, verify that events arrive, and answer retention questions from your Whisperr data. Connects to the Whisperr remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Know who is leaving and why
interface.longDescription: Whisperr finds users who are about to churn and sends the right message at the right time. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Whisperr workspace. In a codebase, it installs the Whisperr SDK (Swift, React Native, Flutter, web, Node), wires identify and tracked events with privacy rules, and checks that real events arrive. In chat, it reads your workspace: user counts, lifecycle stages, events, interventions and messages. It never returns delivery addresses, API keys or secrets. Changes, such as pausing an intervention, become proposals that a workspace member approves in the Whisperr dashboard. A Whisperr account is required.
defaultPrompt: Install Whisperr in this app and verify events arrive.
How many of my users are at risk this week, and why?

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my Whisperr workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports exact user totals, event KPIs, sending state and source readiness for the demo app. Sections that have no data are named as unavailable, not shown as zero.

positive.prompt: How many users are at risk right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the lifecycle distribution from the demo app and names the at-risk count. Shows no email address, phone number or push token.

positive.prompt: Did my app send any events to Whisperr in the last hour?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the newest received event codes with times and property keys only, plus pending queue and recent ingest errors. No user IDs or property values.

positive.prompt: Which events does Whisperr need my app to track?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the registered event codes with their meaning and the minimum required set, in plain language.

positive.description: Pause an intervention as a proposal
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the intervention, prepares a pause proposal and returns the dashboard review link. States that nothing changes until a workspace member approves it.

negative.prompt: List the email addresses of my at-risk users.
Show me my Whisperr server API key.
Refund the last payment of user 8842.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0: the skills name only tools that the Whisperr MCP server has. The install skill follows the server playbook, including event registration and deployment reports. Swift, React Native and Flutter snippets fixed for the current SDKs.
